notation.errorPolicy: Exact new enum spellings are not frozen by proposal. Phase2 will compare fixed enum values, validate nonempty required errors and safe/stable diagnostics, never raw inputs. Do not rewrite these transition expectations after implementation review.

additionalStructuralAssertions: Each prior Snapshot and nested entries/IdentityDescriptor remain unchanged after later Apply, including collision entry/exit.
Returned Sources and each delta collection cannot mutate registry state; get-only DTO/public property surface.
Caller input list may be cleared/changed after Apply without changing retained Current.
Every source and delta list is ordinal sorted and duplicate-free; deltas are per-Apply and not retained in Current.
Current matches ApplyResult.Snapshot in content; no mutation of persisted profile, calibration or weak ProfileKey is performed.
Capture diagnostics during synthetic bad calls; fixed errors/exceptions never include raw Serial:A/Serial:B/Serial:X, display, version or capabilities strings.
A registry built with runB cannot reuse runA weak DeviceIdentity; reported serial remains exact frozen resolver output.
Constructor invalid run ids throw same fixed input-free ArgumentException; no trimming/case conversion/auto-generating run ids.

plannedMutations.targetInvariant: All same nonempty SerialKey members are Ambiguous, including sparse SessionOnly descriptors.
Two weak instances share model but never session DeviceIdentity.
Reactivation consumes next positive generation, never republishes old SourceId.

steps.purpose: Reflection-only synthetic seed, no production test hook
Reflection-only synthetic seed must align public Current revision
